mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community c WHERE c.status='ACTIVE' AND c.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0) AS community_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM building b WHERE b.status='ACTIVE' AND b.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0) AS building_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM building_unit bu JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id WHERE bu.status='ACTIVE' AND b.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0) AS building_unit_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit p JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=p.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id WHERE p.status<>'ARCHIVED' AND b.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0) AS property_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit p JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=p.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id WHERE p.status='ACTIVE' AND b.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0) AS active_property_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit p JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=p.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id WHERE p.status='DRAFT' AND b.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0) AS draft_property_count
